behavior: AC1: A PR opened on personal/resume gets a PR Reviewer Guide comment authored by the reviewer account within 10 minutes
AC2: A push to an open PR updates the same review comment instead of adding a second one
AC3: An unsigned or wrongly signed POST to the webhook endpoint is refused and produces no review; the Secret key is required
AC4: Reviewing never edits the PR: PR_COMMANDS and PUSH_COMMANDS are exactly ["/review"] and GITEA__REPO_SETTING is unset
AC5: The reviewer token carries only the measured scopes, no write:repository, and the account owns nothing
AC6: The three SOPS keys are catalogued and mapped; apply-secrets fails closed without them
verification: poetry run pytest -q tests/test_secrets_orphan_audit.py tests/test_k8s_secrets_apply.py -k pr_agent

behavior: AC7: After gitea-reconcile APPLY every declared repo carries both hooks and a second run changes nothing
AC8: A PR with no reviewer comment after N minutes raises an alert
